description: Summary figure: catalytic/S1 residue matrix across active S1 proteases, characterised SPHs and 8 CG34171 orthologs, plus S1 cavity volume and position-195 solvent exposure
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.colors import ListedColormap

# ---- Panel A: residue identity matrix at chymotrypsin-numbered positions ----
cols=["H57","D102","D189","C191","G193","D194","S195","S214","G216","G226"]
rows={
 "Chymotrypsinogen A (Bos)":     ["H","D","S","C","G","D","S","S","G","G"],
 "Trypsinogen (Bos)":            ["H","D","D","C","G","D","S","S","G","G"],
 "Easter (Dmel, active)":        ["H","D","D","C","G","D","S","S","G","G"],
 "Snake (Dmel, active)":         ["H","D","D","C","G","D","S","S","G","G"],
 "SPE (Dmel, active)":           ["H","D","D","C","G","D","S","S","G","G"],
 "Grass (Dmel, active)":         ["H","D","D","C","G","D","S","S","G","G"],
 "Hayan (Dmel, active)":         ["H","D","D","C","G","D","S","S","G","G"],
 "Masquerade (Dmel, SPH)":       ["H","D","D","C","G","D","G","S","G","G"],
 "PPAF-II (H. diomphalia, SPH)": ["H","D","D","C","G","D","G","A","G","G"],
 "SPCLIP1 (A. gambiae, SPH)":    ["R","N","V","C","R","A","P","S","A","D"],
 "CG34171 (Dmel) D. mel":        ["H","D","Q","C","T","D","F","A","G","V"],
 "CG34171 ortho D. mauritiana":  ["H","D","Q","C","T","D","F","A","G","V"],
 "CG34171 ortho D. yakuba":      ["H","D","Q","C","T","D","F","A","G","V"],
 "CG34171 ortho D. erecta":      ["H","D","Q","C","S","D","F","A","G","V"],
 "CG34171 ortho D. rhopaloa":    ["H","D","R","C","T","D","F","A","G","V"],
 "CG34171 ortho D. madeirensis": ["H","D","H","C","S","D","I","A","G","I"],
 "CG34171 ortho D. suzukii":     ["H","D","L","C","T","D","F","A","G","V"],
 "CG34171 ortho D. ananassae":   ["H","D","T","C","T","D","F","A","G","M"],
}
canon={"H57":{"H"},"D102":{"D"},"D189":{"D","S"},"C191":{"C"},"G193":{"G"},
       "D194":{"D"},"S195":{"S"},"S214":{"S"},"G216":{"G"},"G226":{"G"}}
M=pd.DataFrame(rows).T; M.columns=cols
status=np.array([[1 if M.iloc[i,j] in canon[cols[j]] else 0 for j in range(len(cols))] for i in range(len(M))])

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13.5,8.2))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,width_ratios=[1.45,1],height_ratios=[1,0.82],hspace=0.42,wspace=0.26)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[:,0])
ax.imshow(status,cmap=ListedColormap(["#fbb6ce","#9ae6b4"]),aspect='auto',vmin=0,vmax=1)
for i in range(len(M)):
    for j in range(len(cols)):
        ax.text(j,i,M.iloc[i,j],ha='center',va='center',fontsize=10,
                fontweight='bold' if status[i,j]==0 else 'normal')
ax.set_xticks(range(len(cols))); ax.set_xticklabels(cols,rotation=45,ha='right',fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(M))); ax.set_yticklabels(M.index,fontsize=8.5)
for y in [1.5,6.5,9.5,10.5]: ax.axhline(y,color='k',lw=1.1)
ax.set_title("Chymotrypsin-numbered positions mapped by pairwise alignment\ngreen = canonical residue retained, pink = substituted",fontsize=10)

# ---- Panel B: S1 cavity volume ----
panel=pd.DataFrame({
 "protein":["CG34171","Easter","SPE","Grass","Snake","Masquerade","PPAF-II","SPCLIP1"],
 "klass":["candidate","active","active","active","active","SPH","SPH","SPH"],
 "S1_cavity":[66.2,155.7,160.2,71.0,135.1,112.2,138.6,98.1],
 "oxyNN":[6.63,6.61,4.37,4.10,4.20,4.32,6.48,6.25],
 "SASA195":[63.6,14.7,19.3,19.0,14.6,7.8,16.3,6.6]})
col={"candidate":"#c53030","active":"#2b6cb0","SPH":"#b7791f"}
cl=[col[k] for k in panel.klass]
axb=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
axb.bar(panel.protein,panel.S1_cavity,color=cl)
axb.set_ylabel("S1 cavity volume (A$^3$)",fontsize=9)
axb.tick_params(axis='x',rotation=55,labelsize=8); axb.tick_params(axis='y',labelsize=8)
axb.set_title("Buried probe-accessible volume at the S1 site\n(AlphaFold models, identical grid method)",fontsize=9)

axc=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
axc.bar(panel.protein,panel.SASA195,color=cl)
axc.set_ylabel("SASA of residue 195 (A$^2$)",fontsize=9)
axc.tick_params(axis='x',rotation=55,labelsize=8); axc.tick_params(axis='y',labelsize=8)
axc.set_title("Solvent exposure of the position-195 side chain\nCG34171 Phe222 is an exposed aromatic",fontsize=9)
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
axc.legend(handles=[Patch(color=col[k],label=k) for k in col],fontsize=7,loc='upper right')
plt.show()

print(M.to_string())
print()
print(panel.to_string(index=False))
# conservation score per position across the 8 Drosophila orthologs
orth=M.loc[[i for i in M.index if i.startswith("CG34171")]]
print("\nFraction of 8 Drosophila CG34171 orthologs retaining the canonical residue:")
for j,c in enumerate(cols):
    f=sum(1 for v in orth[c] if v in canon[c])/len(orth)
    print(f"  {c:5s} {f*100:5.1f}%   residues observed: {''.join(sorted(set(orth[c])))}")
